name: Fulgencio Batista
contribution: A Cuban military officer and politician who served as president of Cuba from 1940 to 1944, from 1952 to 1954 and again from 1955 to his resignation in 1959, when he was overthrown in the Cuban Revolution.

checks.lead: Fulgencio Batista y Zaldívar (born Rubén Zaldívar; 16 January 1901 – 6 August 1973) was a Cuban military officer and politician who served as president of Cuba from 1940 to 1944, from 1952 to 1954 and again from 1955 to his resignation in 1959, when he was overthrown in the Cuban Revolution. From 1934 till 1940 he was the de facto leader of Cuba.
